CREATE TABLE entry_template_metric ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, template_id BIGINT NOT NULL, metric_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_template_metric_template FOREIGN KEY (template_id) REFERENCES diary_entry_template (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_template_metric_type FOREIGN KEY (metric_type_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_template_metric_template ON entry_template_metric (template_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_template_metric_type ON entry_template_metric (metric_type_id);
